short_blurb: Licensed Class B builder serving South Pasadena — remodels, ADUs & more.
local_note: South Pasadena homeowners choose Palm Crest Builders for kitchen and bath remodels, room additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations. We know the local building department, design for South Pasadena's mix of housing styles, and manage design, permits, and construction with our own licensed crews. We build throughout South Pasadena, including Mission Street corridor, Marengo, Monterey Hills, and nearby neighborhoods. Every project is built to the California Building Code and backed by our workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in South Pasadena?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the South Pasadena building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in South Pasadena?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and South Pasadena rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my South Pasadena remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
